Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

5.name: Sphere of Influence

Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3804|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds.
